_readme: Manual corrections applied on top of the automatic rules in build_catalogue.py.
Keys are the data-row numbers of 'MEDHOUR PRICE LIST.xlsx' (row 1 = first product).
Only names, categories and generics are set here. Price and stock ALWAYS come
straight from the spreadsheet and can never be overridden.
Most entries fix a unit written one order of magnitude out in the source sheet:
'gm' where a tablet/capsule/injection strength means mg, and 'mg' where a cream
or ointment tube size means g. Every one is listed in CATALOGUE-REVIEW.md so the
pharmacy can confirm it. 'review' marks a row we could not resolve confidently.
